title: Violet Evergarden: Kitto "Ai" wo Shiru Hi ga Kuru no Darou
justification: AniList 101432 (OVA, 1 episode from 2018-07-04, 34 min) is AniDB 12138's special S1 Kitto "Ai" o Shiru Hi ga Kuru no Darou (The Day You Understand "I Love You" Will Surely Come.), aired 2018-07-04. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 21827, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 12138, and the special's title matches AniList's romaji title and the English synonym The day you understand "I love you" will surely come. The parent has no row for S1, so it lands on TVDB 0x1 OVA: Surely, Someday You Will Understand "Love" (2018-07-04) and on TMDB 75214 S0E1 Episode 1 (2018-07-04, 34 min). The recorded collision with AniDB 14840 at 0x2 is gone: overlay/12138.json already sends S2 and S3 to no episode.
